sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Prince Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Jayant Singh Tomar,
the learned A.G.A-I for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
343 of 2020, under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 448 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Patti, District Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 15.11.2020 against four persons, including the applicant, in furtherance of an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C,
alleging that the informant's grandfather had executed a registered gift deed of his house in favour of the informant and his brother.
The informant's uncle Ram Jiyawan (co-accused) had filed a suit for cancellation of a gift deed and the accused persons entered into an agreement to sell the house on 09.10.2020.

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that a civil suit for cancellation of will is pending; that the applicant is neither the executant nor a witness to the execution of the agreement dated 09.10.2020 and that no right of the informant is prejudiciously affected by a mere execution of an agreement to sell and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

In default of any of the conditions mentioned above or it is found that applicant has obtained this order concealing any material facts, the Investigating Officer shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for vacation of this order.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Preeti.
